title: npcs.json — NPC sheets for a MJ Tonnerre campaign (canonical format)
description: Canonical format per references/npc-data-governance.md. Tolerates both containers: bare array [...] OR {"pnj": [...]}. Each sheet distinguishes established_facts (played) and gm_hypotheses (deductions not usable in narration). Two optional private layers (Level 2, audit/06-niveau2-factions.md §4): connaissances_privees (NPC's hidden knowledge, seeded by GM) and notes_privees (agent's inner monologue, appended by the coordinator). One optional dialogue layer: voix (the character's idiolect, cf. references/dialogue-craft.md).

voix.description: OPTIONAL (references/dialogue-craft.md §2④). The character's IDIOLECT — how this mouth works, so two NPCs in a scene are not distinguishable by their name tag alone. Every field is a free-text sentence written for a model to imitate, not an enum. FAIL-OPEN: no `voix` block = no behavior change, the GM writes the voice from `description`/`attitude` and is expected to persist it here the first time the NPC holds a real conversation.

registre.description: Level of language, tone, social distance. Ex.: "formal, archaic, never familiar with strangers".

lexique.description: Words and images this character reaches for — their metaphor field. Ex.: "his comparisons are all bookkeeping: weights, debts, ledgers".

rythme.description: Sentence length, pauses, interruptions. Ex.: "short sentences; stops mid-thought and restarts elsewhere".

tics.description: Verbal signatures. Used SPARINGLY (one appearance every few lines): a tic on every line is a parrot, not a person.

ne_dit_jamais.description: Words and subjects this mouth refuses, and what it substitutes. Ex.: "never says the word 'fae'; says 'them', or 'the other side'".

sous_tension.description: How the voice DEFORMS under stress — the most useful field of the block. Ex.: "becomes courteous and very precise: politeness is his panic".

emotions.description: OPTIONAL (skill mygamemaster-emotions). Character's emotional state: 6 emotions 0..1 (joy, confidence, fear, anger, sadness, surprise). `etat` = current intensities; `temperament` = baseline toward which state decays over time; `history` = capped (20) journal of variations (event, actual deltas, reason, session) — every change is EXPLAINABLE, never arbitrary. Managed by scripts/emotions.py (fail-open: missing object = no behavior change).

established_facts.description: What the NPC has SAID or DONE verbatim in play (traceable to a session).

gm_hypotheses.description: GM deductions/assumptions — forbidden in narration without in-play validation.

connaissances_privees.description: OPTIONAL (Level 2). What the NPC KNOWS but has not revealed — hidden knowledge seeded by GM/tools. The agent sees it (private brief section), players do not. Enables lying/hiding coherently.

notes_privees.description: OPTIONAL (Level 2). Agent's inner monologue: reflections, plans, accumulated suspicions turn after turn. Appended by the coordinator (sole writer) via faction_slice.py add-note. Invisible to all others.
